# Analysis guide

Skills live in `ersilia-skills`; when a skill teaches you something, suggest an improvement.

## Repository structure

Scripts go in `scripts/` and examples in `examples/run_input.csv`. Create `output/` when first needed. Name docs `YYYY-MM-DD_topic.md`.

## Working with the user

- Ask first.

## Version control

- Constants live in `src/default.py`.
- See [`ersilia/utils/logging.py`](https://github.com/ersilia-os/ersilia).
- Lint with `ruff`. Plot with stylia.

## README guidelines

- Short.
